primitives.note: Fury builds from basic attacks (5/hit), Q/E hits (2-10 per hit, capped 30/cast), and R (5/s up to 75 while active); decays 1 per 0.25s after 12s out of combat. At 50+ Fury, the next eligible basic ability is empowered and consumes 50 Fury.
50 Fury must be banked to trigger the empowered version of Q or W; this gates how often the stronger damage numbers can be used inside the 15s window.
W arms the next basic attack to strike twice (thrice if Fury-empowered), each strike dealing separate basic damage and applying on-hit.
Casting W resets Renekton's basic attack timer, effectively giving a free/early attack.
Only W's first strike can critically strike for bonus AD damage.
Cull the Meek deals cleave damage instantly on cast, flat 7s cooldown, free.
Slice and Dice dashes and deals damage; on hit it can be recast (Dice) within 4s as a second, separately-timed damage instance.
The empowered ('Reign of Anger Bonus') Dice recast additionally applies an armor shred for 4s on enemies hit.
Dominus creates an aura dealing magic damage every 0.5s for its 15s duration to nearby enemies.
Dominus grants bonus health, attack range, and continuous Fury generation (5/s, cap 75) for 15s; the health portion is survival-fight relevant.

needsBespoke.why: The kit is a resource (Fury) meter that empowers whichever of Q/W is cast next once it reaches 50, expressed as a combination of stacking-self-buff + resource-budget + empowered-attack/plain-cast primitives. No mechanic here requires logic outside the closed list, though the sim must implement 'shared charge consumed by the next eligible cast, with per-ability different empowered effects' as a resource-budget rule spanning two abilities.
